_설명: 완성 9과 가정법 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다. 긴 지문 문항(종합1 32번, 종합2 32번)은 지문을 새로 쓸 수 없어 틀린 자리를 옮겼다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
body: ⒜ If I (A)______ more carefully last night, I could
⒝ If my sister (B)______ here, I could ask her for
문항.explanation: 주절이 could have면 if절은 had + 과거분사, 주절이 could면 if절의 be동사는 were로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장들의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: ⒜ As I'm not taller, I can't reach the top shelf.
→ If I (A)______ taller, I could reach the top shelf.
⒝ It snowed heavily last night, so the road was
→ If it had not snowed heavily last night, the road
문항.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대는 가정법 과거, 과거 사실의 반대는 가정법 과거완료로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
body: ⒜ If I had won the contest, my parents (A)______
⒝ It (B)______ great if I could speak five languages.
choices: would have been would have been
문항.explanation: if절이 과거완료면 주절은 would have been, if절이 과거면 주절은 would be로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 [[틀린]]문장을 고르시오.
choices: She treats me as if she didn’t know my name.
If we had no electricity, our lives would have been harder.
He plays the piano as if he were a professional.
The fire wouldn’t have spread if they had called earlier.
If I had to live abroad, I would choose Canada.
문항.explanation: if절이 가정법 과거이므로 주절도 would be로 맞춰야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장들의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: ⒜ The water is deep, so I can't walk across the
→ If the water were not deep, I (A)______ across
⒝ As she didn’t practice every day, she lost the
→ If she (B)______ every day, she would not have
문항.explanation: 앞은 현재 사실의 반대, 뒤는 과거 사실의 반대이므로 각각 could walk와 had practiced를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것을 고르시오.
body: ⒜ If Owen (A)______ abroad then, he would be
⒝ If I could read minds, we (B)______ fewer
문항.explanation: ⒜는 과거의 일과 현재의 결과를 잇는 혼합가정법, ⒝는 가정법 과거이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 [[틀린]]것끼리 짝지어진것을 고르시오.
body: (A) If I had started earlier, I wouldn't have been
(B) If Owen hadn’t run so fast, he wouldn't have
(C) If I were my mother, I would have stopped
(D) If the sea were calmer yesterday, I would
(E) There would have been fewer mistakes if
(F) Hana looks as if she hadn’t eaten all day.
문항.explanation: (C)(D)(E)는 if절과 주절의 시제가 어긋나 있다.

문항.prompt: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
body: When you’re eager to get your slice of the pie,
why would you be interested in giving a hand to
choices: [[so that]] they can get their piece? If Ernest Hamwi had taken that attitude when he was selling zalabia, a very thin Persian waf
[[have ended]] his days as a street vendor. Hamwi noticed
[[that]] a nearby ice­cream vendor ran out of bowls to serve to his customers. Most people would have sniffed, “Not my problem,” p
[[hoping]] the ice­cream vendor’s misfortune would mean more customers for them. Instead, Hamwi rolled up a waffle and put a scoop
[[created]] one of the world’s first ice­cream cones. He helped his neighbor and, in the process, made a fortune.
문항.explanation: 앞 문장과 이어지는 분사구문이므로 현재분사 creating으로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말로알맞은 것을 [[모두]]고르시오.
body: <보기> 그 다리가 오늘날에도 여전히 남아 있다면,
= _______ today, it would be a great sight.
choices: If it had been still standing
문항.explanation: 가정법 과거이므로 were를 쓰며, if를 생략하면 were가 주어 앞으로 나온다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ 내가 너라면 그 차를 빌리지 않을 거야.
= If I were you, I (A) _______ the car.
⒝ 만약 그녀가 왔더라면, 그녀는 그를 만났을 것이다.
= If she had come, she would (B) _______ him.
문항.explanation: 가정법 과거의 주절은 「would + 동사원형」, 과거완료의 주절은 「would have + 과거분사」이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
choices: She spoke to me as if she [[had been]] my teacher.
If I were a pilot, I [[would fly]] around the world.
Owen talks as if he [[had visited]] Paris.
She [[would join]] the club if she had known about it.
If I were a fish in the tank, I [[would want]] to swim in the sea.
문항.explanation: if절이 가정법 과거완료이므로 주절도 would have joined로 써야 한다.

문항.포인트: 가정법 과거완료와 as if + 가정법 과거
문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ If you (A) _______ more practice, you could
⒝ My son talks to his toy car as if it (B)_______
문항.explanation: 주절이 could have면 if절은 had had, as if 뒤에는 were를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말이바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ He acts as if he _______ the answer.
= In fact, he knows the answer.
⒝ If we _______ an umbrella, we would have got
= As we took an umbrella, we didn’t get wet.
문항.explanation: as if 뒤는 사실의 반대를, 가정법 과거완료도 과거 사실의 반대를 나타낸다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ Were the story true, they (A) _______ very angry.
⒝ If you (B) _______ me with the moving, I
couldn’t have finished it in a day.
문항.explanation: ⒜는 가정법 과거의 주절, ⒝는 주절이 couldn’t have이므로 if절은 hadn’t helped이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 문장들이 뜻이 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ As he doesn’t have my address, he doesn’t
= If he (A) _______ my address, he would send
⒝ As Dad wasn’t home, we couldn’t borrow the car.
= (B) _______ Dad been home, we could have
문항.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대는 had, if를 생략한 과거완료는 Had가 주어 앞으로 나온다.

문항.포인트: if의 생략과 as if + there were
문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: ⒜ (A) _______ I had a bicycle, I could have made
⒝ The children rehearse in the hall as if
문항.explanation: if를 생략하면 Had가 앞으로 나오고, as if 뒤의 there 구문은 were를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
body: In retrospect, it might seem surprising that
choices: [[as mundane as]] the desire to count sheep was the driving force for an advance as fundamental as written language. But the desir
[[have always accompanied]] economic activity, since transactions are meaningless unless you can clearly keep track of who owns wha
[[is]] [[dominated by]] wheeling and dealing: a collection of bets, bills, and contracts. Long before we had the writings of the p
[[What]] [[survives]] these ancient societies is, for the most part, a pile of receipts. If it weren’t for the commercial enterpri
[[would have known]] far, far less about the cultures that they came from.
문항.explanation: 주어가 단수 the desire이므로 has always accompanied로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 우리말과 일치하는 것은?
body: <보기> 만약 내가 너라면, 나는 그 제안을 거절하지
choices: If I am you, I don’t refuse the offer.
If I was you, I didn’t refuse the offer.
If I were you, I don’t refuse the offer.
If I was you, I wouldn’t refuse the offer.
If I were you, I wouldn’t refuse the offer.
문항.explanation: 가정법 과거에서는 be동사를 were로 쓰고 주절에는 조동사 과거형을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 형태로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> If she practiced more often, she _______
문항.explanation: if절이 과거형이므로 주절은 「조동사 과거형 + 동사원형」으로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> As she didn’t save money, she couldn’t buy
choices: If she saved money, she could buy the laptop.
If she had saved money, she could buy the laptop.
If she saves money, she could have bought the laptop.
If she has saved money, she could have bought the laptop.
If she had saved money, she could have bought the laptop.
문항.explanation: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 if절은 had + 과거분사, 주절은 could have + 과거분사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> The trip might not have gone well if we
문항.explanation: 주절이 might not have gone이므로 if절은 hadn’t had로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 형태로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> Why is she smiling at me as if she _____
문항.explanation: 지금 사실이 아닌 일을 나타내므로 as if 뒤에 과거형을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 그의 팔이 조금 더 길다면, 그는 그것을 잡을 수
→ If his arms were a little longer, he ___________ it.
문항.explanation: 가정법 과거의 주절에는 「could + 동사원형」을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 그녀에게 시간이 조금 있다면, 그녀는 우리를
→ If she __________ some time, she could help us.
문항.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 if절의 동사를 과거형 had로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 [[어색한]]것은?
choices: If I were him, I would change my mind.
If I had another chance, I would try again.
If the sea was calm, I could go sailing.
He could finish it today, if he started now.
If it were not for your advice, I wouldn’t succeed.
문항.explanation: 가정법 과거에서는 주어에 상관없이 were를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> As I don’t have a license, I can’t drive the
→ I ________________ the truck if I had a license.
문항.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 주절은 could drive로 쓴다.

문항.포인트: were to — 일어나기 어려운 일의 가정
문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 네가 다시 학생이 된다면, 여전히 같은 전공을
→ If you _______________ be a student again, would
you still choose the same major?
문항.explanation: 일어날 가능성이 낮은 일을 가정할 때는 「were to + 동사원형」을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
body: <보기> 그가 늦지 않았다면, 그는 그 기차를 탈 수
→ If he ___________________, he could have caught
문항.explanation: 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 hadn’t been late로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> As it snowed last night, we couldn’t go
choices: If it didn‘t snow, we could go hiking.
If it snowed, we could go hiking last night.
We could have gone hiking if it had snowed last night.
We couldn‘t have gone hiking if it had not snowed last night.
If it had not snowed last night, we could have gone hiking.
문항.explanation: 눈이 오지 않았다면 갈 수 있었을 것이라는 과거 사실의 반대이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 가장 알맞은 것은?
body: (1) If you ______ called me earlier, I could have
(2) If I had known your address, I would have
문항.explanation: (1)은 if절의 had, (2)는 주절의 would have 뒤에 오는 과거분사 자리이므로 공통으로 들어갈 말은 had이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 통해 추론할 수 있는 것은?
body: <보기> He talks as if he were a doctor.
choices: In fact, he can‘t speak English at all.
In fact, I‘ve never met him at a hospital.
In fact, he is not a doctor.
In fact, he has never been to a hospital.
문항.explanation: as if 뒤의 가정법 과거는 지금 사실이 아님을 나타낸다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?
body: (A) My daughter talks to her puppy as if it _____
(B) Owen _____ as if he had run a marathon.
문항.explanation: as if 뒤에는 were를 쓰고, 뒤 문장은 과거완료와 짝이 되도록 주절을 과거형으로 쓴다.
